decisions: Crypto planning uses T023 crypto UTC sessions and continuous inclusive calendar dates, not XNYS sessions, holidays, or close times.
Each pair-day is grouped into one deterministic queue message with UTC-midnight start and next-midnight close bounds; current open days use the injected clock as the provider end bound.
The crypto transaction builds on T057 normalized crypto client methods, T022 writer semantics, T024 CoverageRecord keys, and the T034 atomic committer boundary.

The shared T035 QueueWorker is constructed by create_crypto_worker with injected queue, worker clock, client, writer, committer, and current-time clock; successful delivery deletes only after the transaction commits.
Deterministic date-first crypto object paths and catalog logical keys are replaced on every retry or partial-day refresh, making duplicate delivery idempotent without process-local deduplication.
Focused tests use provider, writer, committer, queue, worker-clock, and current-time fakes only; no live Alpaca, Azure, credentials, or network access was used.
limitations: The existing repository-wide ruff format check remains blocked by an unrelated pre-existing formatting issue in src/lake/option_backfill.py; that file was outside T058 scope and was not changed.
No MyPy run was performed; repository tooling uses Ruff and ty.
No live provider or Azure data-plane operation was run.
